title: The Boy Who Cried Wolf
moral: Always tell the truth, about big things and little things, so that people can believe you when it matters most; and when you make a mistake, saying sorry and telling the truth is the first step back.
how_to: Every prompt in prompt_manifest.json is a template rendered from this file by production/image_prompts.py --story boy_who_cried_wolf_v1 (build, lint, show, md, review). Character identities are design specs until each canonical image is approved; then rewrite them from the image (hex sampled from it) and rebuild.

ben.name: Farmer Ben
ben.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
ben.identity: Farmer Ben is one tall, broad, friendly wool-felt man, a soft storybook doll, about one and a half times Finn's height. His skin is tan felt (#D69A6E) with ruddy cheeks (#C9785E). He has a short bushy chestnut-brown beard (#6B4226) and short chestnut-brown hair under a round straw-yellow hat (#D9B75C) with a brown band. Two friendly round glossy eyes: dark-brown irises (#4A2E1E), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F6F0E6); two thick chestnut-brown brows; a round nose. He wears denim-blue overalls (#4F6F9E) over a cream shirt (#F2E8D5) with rolled-up sleeves, and big dark-brown boots (#4A3020). Two strong arms with large four-fingered hands. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
ben.sheet: one tall broad felt farmer with a chestnut-brown beard, a straw-yellow hat, two dark-brown eyes, denim-blue overalls over a cream shirt and dark-brown boots
ben.short: Farmer Ben is one tall broad felt farmer with a chestnut-brown beard, a straw-yellow hat, two dark-brown eyes, denim-blue overalls over a cream shirt and dark-brown boots.
ben.mouth: When Farmer Ben's mouth opens, it is a rounded opening with a dark warm-brown interior and a soft pink tongue, framed by his beard.
checklist: one tall man, two arms, two legs
round straw-yellow hat with a brown band
denim-blue overalls over a cream shirt
about one and a half of Finn's height
colours not shifted by scene light

rosie.name: Grandma Rosie
rosie.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
rosie.identity: Grandma Rosie is one round, cosy, elderly wool-felt woman, a soft storybook doll, about one and a third times Finn's height. Her skin is warm peach felt (#EBB896) with rosy-pink cheeks (#E08A7A) and soft smile lines. Her hair is silver-white felt (#E6E2DA) pulled up into a round bun on top of her head. Two kind round glossy eyes: warm brown irises (#6A4228), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F6F0E6); two soft silver-white brows; a small rounded nose and a gentle mouth line. She wears a long lavender-purple dress (#8E7AB5) with short puffed sleeves and a long cream apron (#F2E6CF) with one front pocket, and small dark-brown shoes (#4A3020). Two arms with small four-fingered hands; a round, plump figure. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. Her pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.

rosie.short: Grandma Rosie is one round elderly felt grandmother with a silver-white bun, rosy cheeks, two kind brown eyes, a long lavender-purple dress and a cream apron.
rosie.mouth: When Grandma Rosie's mouth opens, it is a small rounded opening with a dark warm-brown interior and a soft pink tongue.
checklist: one elderly woman, two arms, two legs
silver-white hair in a round bun
long lavender-purple dress with puffed sleeves
long cream apron with one pocket
about one and a third of Finn's height
colours not shifted by scene light

lena.name: Lena
lena.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image

Her hair is dark-brown felt (#3E2A1E) in two long braids tied with small sunflower-yellow ribbons (#F2C230). Two large round glossy eyes: dark-brown irises (#3E2A1E), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F6F0E6); two short dark-brown brows; a small nose and a bright mouth line. She wears a sky-blue dress (#7FB2DA) with a white collar (#F8F4EC) and small red shoes (#B8433A). Two arms with small four-fingered hands and two slim legs. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. finn.name: Finn
finn.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
finn.identity: Finn is one young wool-felt boy of about eight, a soft storybook doll with a round head about one fifth of his height. His skin is warm peach felt (#F2C29B) with rosy-pink cheeks (#E8907E) and a few tiny cinnamon-brown freckle stitches (#A8653C) across his nose. His hair is a mop of short curly copper-orange felt (#C86A2C) that covers his ears' tops and his forehead. Two large round glossy eyes, each about a fifth of the head width: hazel-green irises (#7A8A3A), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F6F0E6); two short copper-orange brows; a small rounded nose and a small mouth line. He wears a moss-green knitted tunic (#5E7A3A) with a round collar, a short red scarf (#C0392B) knotted at the neck, brown felt trousers (#7A5236) and small dark-brown boots (#4A3020). Two arms with small four-fingered hands and two legs; slim, like a child. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.

finn.short: Finn is one young felt boy with curly copper-orange hair, rosy cheeks and freckles, two hazel-green eyes, a moss-green tunic, a short red scarf, brown trousers and dark-brown boots.
finn.mouth: When Finn's mouth opens, it is a small rounded opening with a dark warm-brown interior, a soft pink tongue and a neat row of small ivory upper teeth.
checklist: one boy, two arms, two legs, four fingers per hand
head about one fifth of his height
colours not shifted by scene light

wolf.name: the Wolf
wolf.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
wolf.identity: The Wolf is one long, lanky, rather silly wool-felt wolf who walks on four long legs, more funny than frightening. His fur felt is soft smoke-grey (#8A8D93), lighter pale-grey on the muzzle, chest and belly (#D3D5D8), with darker charcoal-grey tips on his two tall pointed ears and his back (#4E5157). His long rounded muzzle ends in a big round black nose (#222222). Two round glossy eyes: golden-yellow irises (#D9A93A), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F4EEE2); two expressive charcoal-grey brows. His mouth is a long wavy closed line, and his teeth are hidden. One big bushy smoke-grey tail with a pale-grey tip. Long thin legs with soft round paws. Standing on four legs he is about three quarters of Finn's height to his ear tips. Rounded soft shapes everywhere, no sharp edges. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. His pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
wolf.sheet: one long lanky smoke-grey felt wolf with a pale-grey muzzle and chest, tall pointed ears, two golden-yellow eyes, a big black nose and a big bushy tail, more silly than scary
wolf.short: the Wolf is one long lanky smoke-grey felt wolf with a pale-grey muzzle and chest, tall pointed ears, two golden-yellow eyes, a big black nose and a big bushy tail, more silly than scary.
wolf.mouth: When the Wolf's mouth opens, it is a long rounded opening with a dark warm-brown interior and a long pink tongue; his teeth stay hidden.
checklist: one wolf, four legs, one bushy tail
soft smoke-grey fur with a pale-grey muzzle and chest
two tall pointed ears with charcoal tips
about three quarters of Finn's height

sheep.name: the Sheep
sheep.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
sheep.identity: Each of the flock's sheep is the same: one round, friendly wool-felt ewe who walks on four legs, with a big fluffy body of cream-white curly felt (#EFE6D2), a smooth pale biscuit-beige face and lower legs (#D9C3A0), two small soft ears sticking out sideways with rosy-pink insides (#E3A39A), two round glossy eyes with dark-brown irises (#4A2E1E), black pupils, ivory sclera and one white catch-light, a small rosy-pink nose (#E3A39A), a small smiling mouth line, a short fluffy tail and four little dark hooves. Each sheep is about half of Finn's height to the top of her head and has no horns. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. Their pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.
sheep.sheet: a round fluffy cream-white felt sheep with a biscuit-beige face and legs, small ears with rosy-pink insides and two dark-brown eyes
sheep.short: the Sheep is a round fluffy cream-white felt sheep with a biscuit-beige face and legs, small ears with rosy-pink insides and two dark-brown eyes.
sheep.mouth: When a sheep bleats, its mouth opens in a small rounded shape with a soft pink inside.
checklist: biscuit-beige face and legs, no horns

daisy.name: Daisy
daisy.status: design spec: rewrite from the approved canonical image
daisy.identity: Daisy is one small young wool-felt lamb who walks on four thin legs. Her fleece is a fluffy cloud of cream-white curly felt (#F4EEDF). Her face, ears and lower legs are soft charcoal-black felt (#2E2A28), with one white heart-shaped patch (#FBF8F2) on her forehead above her nose. Two small ears stick out sideways with rosy-pink insides (#E8A3A0). Two large round glossy eyes: warm amber-brown irises (#8A5A22), black pupils, one white catch-light at upper right, ivory sclera (#F6F0E6); a small rosy-pink nose (#E8A3A0) and a small smiling mouth line. A short fluffy cream-white tail. Four little dark hooves. She is about a third of Finn's height. Fine looped felt fibres and small visible stitches. These intrinsic colours and this mid brightness stay identical in every image; scene light only tints and shades them. Her pose, facing and expression are the ones this prompt states.

daisy.short: Daisy is one small fluffy cream-white felt lamb with a charcoal-black face and legs, a white heart-shaped patch on her forehead, rosy-pink ear insides and two amber-brown eyes.
daisy.mouth: When Daisy bleats, her mouth opens in a small rounded shape with a soft pink inside.
checklist: one lamb, four legs, one short tail
white heart-shaped patch on the forehead
ears sticking out sideways with pink insides
about a third of Finn's height

blocks.style: Style: handcrafted wool-felt stop-motion storybook miniature; softly stuffed matte forms, tactile looped wool fibres, fine visible stitching and gentle handmade irregularities; warm child-friendly palette and soft directional light; clear subject silhouettes; faces and contact points sharply readable.
blocks.runtime_style: Handcrafted matte wool-felt stop-motion miniature, tactile fibres and stitching, softly lit, sharp readable subjects.
blocks.light_and_colour: Light and colour: every character keeps exactly the colours, saturation and brightness of its canonical image; the scene light may only tint it the same way it tints the background, with the same exposure and contrast as the background. Characters are lit from the same direction as the plate and cast soft contact shadows on its ground, so they sit in the scene rather than on top of it.
blocks.final_check: Before finishing, check: each named character appears exactly once and the flock has exactly the number of sheep the cast line states; every character has exactly two eyes and two eyebrows (one above each eye, drawn once), its canonical ears, hair, clothes, limbs and hands or hooves, and each animal exactly one tail attached at its root; no text, letters, labels or watermark anywhere.
blocks.edit_end_frame: This is an edit of the accepted start frame of this shot (the first attached reference): keep its camera, crop, background, light and every character's identity, colours, brightness, size and position exactly; change only what this frame shows below.
blocks.edit_reference: Edit the first attached reference, the approved parent image: keep the character's identity, colours, brightness and proportions exactly; change only the view or pose stated here.
blocks.edit_expression: Edit the first attached reference, the approved closed-mouth portrait: keep its crop, head size and position, every feature, colour, the felt texture, the whiskers, the backdrop and the light exactly; change only the brows, eyelids, gaze and mouth.
blocks.studio_full_body: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop, soft even neutral light and a small soft contact shadow under the feet; the whole body, ears, paws, mane where present and the single tail inside the frame with about 8% margin on every side.
blocks.studio_portrait: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop filling the frame edge to edge, with no room, furniture, floor or horizon, and soft even neutral light; head-and-shoulders crop with the whole head, both ears and any mane inside the frame with a small margin; the head keeps the size and eye-line of the approved closed-mouth portrait.
blocks.plate_rules: Empty plate: no characters and no story props. Normal-height camera, the whole scene edge to edge, open in-focus ground where characters will stand, distant background slightly soft. Every landmark keeps the position stated above; a different light state of this place reuses exactly the same geometry.
blocks.cast_scale: Relative size (fixed for the whole story, the same at the same distance from the camera), with Finn's height as 1: Farmer Ben 1.5 (1.6 with his hat), Grandma Rosie 1.33, Lena 1.05, the Wolf 0.75 to his ear tips on four legs, each sheep 0.55 to the top of her head, Daisy 0.35. The adults are clearly taller than the children, and Daisy is clearly smaller than every sheep. Sitting, kneeling, crouching or running changes a silhouette but never the size of a head or limb.
blocks.studio_lineup: Studio: plain warm off-white seamless backdrop filling the frame edge to edge, soft even neutral light, one flat ground line at y=0.88 where every character stands, with a small soft contact shadow under each; every whole body, every ear tip, foot and tail inside the frame with a margin.

reference_roles.edit_base: the edit base ({what}): keep everything in it (camera, crop, background, light, every character's identity, colours, brightness, size and position) except what this prompt changes
reference_roles.identity_root: {who}'s approved canonical image: copy {who}'s identity exactly, with the same shapes, proportions, colours and brightness
reference_roles.locked_plate: the locked location plate ({what}): reproduce this background exactly, with the same landmarks, light and camera
reference_roles.world_state: the previous accepted frame ({what}): carry over the world state (props, damage, contacts and positions) unless this prompt changes it; use the framing stated in this prompt
reference_roles.camera_geometry: camera and layout reference ({what}): copy only the camera position and the layout of the place; take no character or prop state from it
reference_roles.expression: expression reference ({what}): copy only the brows, eyelids, gaze and mouth shape onto {who}'s canonical face
reference_roles.pose: pose reference ({what}): copy only {who}'s body pose and proportions, not the background
reference_roles.prop: prop reference ({what}): copy the prop's material, colour, shape and size; its state in this frame is the one stated in this prompt
reference_roles.mouth_design: mouth design reference ({what}): copy only the mouth opening, the teeth and their size
reference_roles.staging_only: older-version staging reference ({what}): copy only the composition, camera and staging; every character's look comes from the canonical images
reference_roles.size_anchor: size anchor ({what}): an approved frame of this same camera setup; every character keeps exactly the size it has there, and takes no pose, expression or prop state from it
reference_roles.framing: framing reference ({what}): copy only the shot size, where the head sits in the frame and how strongly the background is blurred; take no character, background, light or expression from it
reference_roles.size_lineup: the story's size lineup ({what}): copy only the size relation between Leo and Milo, applied at the sizes stated in this prompt; take no camera, background, pose, expression or prop state from it
